title: Why small habits matter
description: A practical introduction to building sustainable habits.

scenes.heading: Start smaller
scenes.narration: A habit is easier to repeat when the first step is small. Instead of planning an hour of reading, start with one page.

scenes.heading: Attach a cue
scenes.body: Connect it to an existing routine.
scenes.narration: Choose a routine you already follow, like making coffee, and attach your new habit to it.

scenes.heading: Repeat and adjust
scenes.narration: Track your progress, adjust when something is not working, and return to the routine after a missed day. Small actions are a starting point, not a guarantee of results.
